scope: Exact set coverage of the retained IEEE degenerate face geometry by nondegenerate triangles of the same material group. No face removed and no coordinate moved.
interpretation: Removing just these zero-area faces would preserve the encoded surface point set; this does not establish preservation of intrinsic chart area, mesh topology, contacts or exposure admission.
candidate_filter: Closed AABB overlap of exact IEEE coordinate minima/maxima only.
exact_predicate: Rational plane intersection followed by three closed projected half-planes; exact union of all closed parameter intervals on each entire segment, or exact point containment.

groups.scope: Encoded IEEE surface point-set coverage within this supplied group only; no change to geometry or admission.
groups.method: Exact rational segment/triangle intersections, closed half-plane clipping and full interval union; AABB candidates only.
